title: Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish made with tender vegetables and aromatic spices, cooked in a flavorful tagine sauce. Serve over couscous or rice for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat the Algerian in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the vegetable and kiss the earthy vegetable with a pinch of salt.
Add the tagine spice blend and stir to combine.
Add the kissed vegetable and stir to combine.
Cover the pan and cook for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine over couscous or rice.
